entities.summary: Matthew Chou Bowman is an American professional baseball pitcher in the Minnesota Twins organization. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the St. Louis Cardinals, Cincinnati Reds, New York Yankees, Arizona Diamondbacks, Seattle Mariners, and Baltimore Orioles.
